say:1:1641106001:1.text: Gold, business plans, and Bradduck's private ration packs... This bag keeps getting heavier and heavier.
say:1:1641106001:1.source_cn: 金币、商业计划书、布拉达克一世的特供粮……这包真是越来...
say:1:1641106001:1.male: Gold, business plans, and Bradduck's private ration packs... This bag keeps getting heavier and heavier.
say:1:1641106001:1.female: Gold, business plans, and Bradduck's private ration packs... This bag keeps getting heavier and heavier.

say:2:1641106002:1.text: The Lyceum really ought to invent a magic backpack—
say:2:1641106002:1.source_cn: 要是莱希拉姆学院能研制出一款魔法背包就好了——
say:2:1641106002:1.male: The Lyceum really ought to invent a magic backpack—
say:2:1641106002:1.female: The Lyceum really ought to invent a magic backpack—

say:3:1641106003:1.text: One that looks small but holds, say, an entire storeroom of stuff.
say:3:1641106003:1.source_cn: 外表轻巧，内里却足以装下无穷无尽的物品。
say:3:1641106003:1.male: One that looks small but holds, say, an entire storeroom of stuff.
say:3:1641106003:1.female: One that looks small but holds, say, an entire storeroom of stuff.

say:4:1641106004:1.text: I'll be first in line to buy it!
say:4:1641106004:1.source_cn: 真有了它，我绝对会成为第一个买家！
say:4:1641106004:1.male: I'll be first in line to buy it!
say:4:1641106004:1.female: I'll be first in line to buy it!
